fields.description: Official Partner API origin. Foodpanda catalog testing uses a designated live test vendor; there is no separate catalog sandbox hostname.
fields.label: API Host

fields.description: Default chain ID used only when a Foodpanda Outlet has no chain ID of its own. Each branch can have a separate chain — set Chain ID on Foodpanda Outlet.
fields.label: Default Chain ID

fields.description: OAuth client-credentials secret used to obtain access tokens. Never exported as a fixture - set this directly on each site.
fields.label: Client Secret

fields.description: Exact static Authorization value configured in Foodpanda Vendor Portal for order and assortment callbacks. It may be an opaque token or the complete Basic value. Never exported as a fixture.
fields.label: Webhook Secret

fields.description: Locale key used for localized catalog title and description values.
fields.label: Catalog Locale

fields.description: Allow the beta Add Products API for unmapped SKUs. Enable only after Foodpanda confirms the account and designated test vendor are enabled for product creation.
fields.label: Allow Product Creation

fields.description: Foodpanda central vendor-automation SFTP host. Shared by every outlet; the uploaded filename identifies the vendor.
fields.label: SFTP Host

fields.description: Foodpanda SFTP always uses port 22, regardless of chain.
fields.label: SFTP Port

fields.description: SFTP password. Never exported as a fixture.
fields.label: SFTP Password

fields.description: Remote folder for catalog-only (double-file) uploads. Usually Catalog. Leave blank to upload into the SFTP login home. Do not use a leading slash on chrooted accounts.
fields.label: SFTP Remote Path

fields.description: Must match the prefix configured in Foodpanda Vendor Portal → Integrations. Uploaded file is {prefix}_{vendor_id}.csv. Do not put the vendor ID in this prefix.
fields.label: SFTP Filename Prefix
